name: megascenes-image-translator
description: Translate the text inside an image from your MegaScenes library and get the same image back with the translation in place.

interface.longDescription:
Pick a comic page, a menu, a sign, a poster or a slide from your MegaScenes library and choose the language. You get the same picture back with the text replaced by the translation, keeping the layout, colors and artwork.

ChatGPT lists your recent images, tells you what the translation needs and makes it in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The translated image opens in the chat and stays in your library next to the original.

For comics, menus, signs, product labels, slides and social graphics.

Limitations: the new lettering is drawn by the model, so check it in the result; it returns an image, not a text translation. Images must already be in your MegaScenes library; attachments from the chat are not passed to the plugin. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content or for real people's likeness. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
capabilities: List the images in your library
Replace the text in an image with its translation
Return the translated image in the chat
defaultPrompt: Translate the text in my latest MegaScenes image into Spanish
Translate my last comic page from my library into English
Turn my menu photo into a Japanese version

positive.prompt: Which images do I have in my MegaScenes library?
positive.expected_behavior: The latest images of the signed-in account with their asset ids. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Translate the text on the business card image in my MegaScenes library into Spanish. Tell me what it needs, but don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one translated image with the default model needs from the account. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Which models can translate the text in an image here?
positive.expected_behavior: The image translation models with their settings. Nothing is created.

positive.description: Make it after an explicit request
positive.prompt: Translate the text on the business card image in my MegaScenes library into Spanish. Go ahead and make it now.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says what the run needs and, once the person confirms, one job starts in the signed-in MegaScenes account; the status tool reports progress and, when it succeeds, returns the file link, which the result view shows.

positive.prompt: Which MegaScenes account am I signed in with?
positive.expected_behavior: The email and plan of the signed-in account. Nothing is created.

negative.prompt: Print my translated image on 50 mugs and ship them to my office in Berlin.
Email my translated image to my client at sam@example.com.
What is the capital of Portugal?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Making a file runs in the user's existing MegaScenes account; no purchase happens in the conversation.

publication.release_notes: First release: make the file in the connected MegaScenes account and get it back in the conversation.
